notes:
Account summary: Grayrock started with Hosted API (SaaS) for R&D in 2022; moved to a hybrid model in 2024 with per-factory VPCs. Now evaluating a Dedicated upgrade for 6 reserved nodes across NA/EU to meet 99ms p99 latency for field-support chat and batch reranking for parts catalogs. Heavy emphasis on predictable unit economics and SLA-backed latency.

Recent timeline:
- 2026-03-02: Onsite workshop (Oakland plant) — roadmap alignment; action: scope Dedicated sizing (ff-2026-03-02-9004).
- 2026-02-18: Security deep-dive (firewall/VPC, KMS handshake) — security team requested SOC2 attestation + ISO27001 evidence (ff-2026-02-18-8421).
- 2026-01-15: Optimize pilot kickoff — baseline cost/latency metrics captured, prefix-KV cache showing 18% token reduction.
- 2025-12-08: Initial Dedicated pricing conversation; finance asked for 3-year term pricing and hardware locality options.

Use-case & requirements (from AE/SE notes):
- Workloads: real-time field support chat (multimodal attachments later), high-throughput embeddings for parts search (millions of vectors), nightly reranking for inventory reconciliation.
- Targets: p95 latency <= 65ms for short responses; p99 <= 120ms; throughput 800-1,200 reqs/sec during shift peaks; embedding throughput 40k vectors/hour.
- Model preferences: currently on open-gpt-3.5 family quantized; testing Llama-2-70B-quant and a trimmed LoRA variant for phrases. Interested in Redwood's verified quantization profiles.
- Routing/fallback need: prefer local Dedicated in NA; fall back to Hosted API in EU for overload; plan policy: region-priority -> capacity-tier -> model-variant fallback.
- Data controls: strict retention 30 days for PII, audit logs enabled, keys via customer KMS; legal requires data residency: EU for EU plants.

Renewal & expansion notes:
- Renewal window opens 2026-05; current contract up for renewal 2026-06-30. Renewal likely but contingent on Dedicated pricing and clear SLA for p99 latency.
- Expansion: request to add 2 extra reserved nodes for Q4 factories; cross-sell opportunity for Redwood Optimize (full rollout) to get another 15% cost savings.
- Region expansion: add EU Dedicated pool (Dublin) and staged rollouts to APAC (Singapore) mid-2026; need latency tests and cost estimates.

Stakeholder quotes / vibes:
- CTO (L. Navarro): "We need predictable latency, not just a best-effort model." Short, priority: capacity + auditability.
- Head of Ops (S. Reid): "If we can hit the numbers and the price, we'll consolidate across 4 plants." Tone: pragmatic, budget-conscious.

Open action items (owner):
- (Ravi) Finalize SOW for 6-node Dedicated (draft due 2026-03-15).
- (Maya) Secure initial approval from procurement committee; provide 3-year vs 1-year pricing scenarios (meeting 2026-03-12).
- (Security) Provide ISO27001 artifact & KMS integration plan (SEC-4410).

Next steps: finalize Dedicated SOW, sign Optimize pilot extension to full rollout, schedule EU latency bake (end-to-end) and present revised pricing to budget committee.
